title: Taxi Card Skimmer
scenario: A driver says your card failed and asks you to tap again on a handheld device.

answers.A: Tap repeatedly until the payment goes through.
answers.B: Ask for a receipt and use one verified terminal once.
answers.C: Use the official taxi app or another licensed payment method.
answers.D: Tap again while watching the amount on the screen.

explanation: Repeated taps can create duplicate charges or expose a skimming device. Check the amount, request a receipt, and use a trusted payment route.
proTip: One ride, one verified amount, one receipt.
